Corners and normals of 3D VMobjects

Source: R/three_dimensions.R
get_3d_vmob_start_corner_index.Rd

Helpers that the 3D camera uses to shade a VMobject() face.

Usage

get_3d_vmob_start_corner_index(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_end_corner_index(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_start_corner(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_end_corner(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_gradient_start_and_end_points(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_unit_normal(vmob, point_index)

get_3d_vmob_start_corner_unit_normal(vmob)

get_3d_vmob_end_corner_unit_normal(vmob)

Arguments

vmob

A VMobject.

point_index

A 0 based row index into vmob$points.

Value

An integer index, a point, a list of two points, or a unit vector.

Details

  • get_3d_vmob_start_corner_index() and get_3d_vmob_end_corner_index() return the row of vmob$points holding the start and end corner. These indices are 0 based, as upstream: the corner is vmob$points[index + 1, ].

  • get_3d_vmob_start_corner() and get_3d_vmob_end_corner() return those points (ORIGIN for an empty mobject), and get_3d_vmob_gradient_start_and_end_points() returns both as a list.

  • get_3d_vmob_unit_normal() returns the unit normal at the 0 based point index point_index, from the anchors three rows before and after it (wrapping around). It returns UP for mobjects with two anchors or fewer. get_3d_vmob_start_corner_unit_normal() and get_3d_vmob_end_corner_unit_normal() evaluate it at the corners.

Examples

sq <- Square()$rotate(PI / 3, axis = RIGHT)
get_3d_vmob_end_corner_index(sq) # 0 based
#> [1] 6
get_3d_vmob_end_corner(sq)
#> [1] -1.0000000 -0.1666667 -0.2886751
get_3d_vmob_start_corner_unit_normal(sq)
#> [1]  0.0000000 -0.8660254  0.5000000
